0022600034.text: The Pacers (4-8, third in the Central and four games back, on a one-game winning streak) host the Knicks (6-5, fifth in the East and 3.5 games back in the Atlantic, on a one-game losing streak) in the 13th game of Indiana's season and an Emirates NBA Cup East Group B matchup. Indiana is missing Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain, 21.8 points per game this season), Ben Sheppard (knee), and Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), while Aaron Nesmith is day-to-day with knee soreness and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Pacers lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 136-110 loss in New York on March 17.
